avis.titre: ANUA Rice 70 Intensive Moisturizing Milk - New Holy Grail

There is a subtle, barely noticeable scent and it never irritates my skin. What really impressed me was the instant hydration boost. My skin drinks it up immediately, leaving it plump and dewy without feeling sticky. The rice extract works wonders on my dry areas and my skin tone noticeably more even and bright. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

The bottle itself is clean, simple, and very "Anua" — minimalistic but elegant. It comes in a pump dispensing bottle. I love that it's a fragrance-free formula, which is a must-have for my reactive skin. The consistency is what I'd call a true milky lotion — not quite a toner, not quite a moisturizer, but that perfect middle step between the two. It's lightweight, silky, and absorbs beautifully without leaving any stickiness or tackiness behind. If you're someone who struggles with layering products due to pilling or heaviness, this is your dream texture. It soaks right in and plays well with both serums and thicker creams. One of my favorite changes has been the improvement in my skin tone. I didn't even realize how dull my complexion had become until I started noticing a glow again—especially on my cheeks and forehead. The niacinamide definitely helps with brightness and overall clarity. My acne scars and redness have faded a bit too, and I feel more confident going without makeup. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

For the price
